snippet.title: POD v0.0.4
snippet.description: Classical retro game, where you move a growing line of resque-pod's through a field of asteroids. Use your skills to steer a string of pods through a field of various asteroids, try to get as far as possible and beat the highscore! Retro gaming at it's core
